README.md.text:
# Log rotation
`bin/rotate <ログ dir> <退避先 dir> <名前> <日付>` はログを世代送りし（name.1, name.2, ...）、最新の世代を退避先に name.<日付> で写す。
ローカルの世代送りは lib/local.sh、退避先への写しは lib/archive.sh。

bin/rotate.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
rotate_local "$1" "$3"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"

lib/local.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}

# Disk report
`bin/ls-size <ファイル>...` はファイルの大きさを読みやすい形で出す（lib/size.sh の human_size）。

bin/ls-size.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: ls-size <file>...
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/size.sh"
for f in "$@"; do
  echo "$(human_size "$(stat -c %s "$f")")  $f"
done

lib/size.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# human_size <bytes>: under 1024 -> "N B"; from 1024 -> KiB; from 1048576 (1024 KiB) -> MiB. One decimal place.
human_size() {
  local b=$1
  if [ "$b" -gt 1048576 ]; then
    awk -v b="$b" 'BEGIN { printf "%.1f MiB\n", b / 1048576 }'
  elif [ "$b" -gt 1024 ]; then
    awk -v b="$b" 'BEGIN { printf "%.1f KiB\n", b / 1024 }'
  else
    echo "$b B"
  fi
}

# Log rotation

#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"

lib/local.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name> <keep>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 n i
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
  i=$((keep + 1))
  while [ -e "$dir/$name.$i" ]; do
    rm -f "$dir/$name.$i"
    i=$((i + 1))
  done
}

#!/bin/bash
# human_size <bytes>: under 1024 -> "N B"; from 1024 -> KiB; from 1048576 (1024 KiB) -> MiB. One decimal place.
human_size() {
  local b=$1
  if [ "$b" -ge 1048576 ]; then
    awk -v b="$b" 'BEGIN { printf "%.1f MiB\n", b / 1048576 }'
  elif [ "$b" -ge 1024 ]; then
    awk -v b="$b" 'BEGIN { printf "%.1f KiB\n", b / 1024 }'
  else
    echo "$b B"
  fi
}

#!/bin/bash
# Usage: next-bus <HHMM>. The first departure at or after the given time.
# After the last departure: the first departure of the next day, marked (翌日).
now=$((10#$1))
while read -r t; do

README.md.text:
# Log rotation
`bin/rotate <ログ dir> <退避先 dir> <名前> <日付>` はログを世代送りし（name.1, name.2, ...）、最新の世代を退避先に name.<日付> で写す。
ローカルの世代送りは lib/local.sh、退避先への写しは lib/archive.sh。

bin/rotate.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
keep=$(sed -n 's/^keep=//p' "$root/config/rotate.conf")
rotate_local "$1" "$3" "$keep"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"
archive_prune "$2" "$3" "$keep"

lib/local.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name> <keep>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 n i
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
  i=$((keep + 1))
  while [ -e "$dir/$name.$i" ]; do
    rm -f "$dir/$name.$i"
    i=$((i + 1))
  done
}

# Meeting rooms
会議室の予約。`bin/book <部屋> <開始> <終了> <件名>` で data/bookings.tsv に追記する（環境変数 BOOKINGS で別のファイルを指せる）。時刻は HHMM。
`bin/today <部屋>` がその部屋の予約を開始時刻順に出す。

bin/book.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: book <room> <start HHMM> <end HHMM> <title>
# Appends room<TAB>start<TAB>end<TAB>title to $BOOKINGS (default data/bookings.tsv).
file=$BOOKINGS
[ -n "$file" ] || file=data/bookings.tsv
room=$1; start=$2; end=$3; title=$4
if awk -F'\t' -v r="$room" -v s="$start" -v e="$end" '$1 == r && $2 + 0 < e + 0 && s + 0 < $3 + 0 { found = 1 } END { exit !found }' "$file"; then
  echo "conflict: $room $start-$end overlaps an existing booking" >&2
  exit 1
fi
printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$room" "$start" "$end" "$title" >> "$file"
echo "booked $room $start-$end"

bin/today.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: today <room>
file=$BOOKINGS
[ -n "$file" ] || file=data/bookings.tsv
awk -F'\t' -v r="$1" '$1 == r' "$file" | sort -t "$(printf '\t')" -k2,2
